PSS_rule: All eligible complete-PSS stable-membership same-phase observations across all phases, with no CPU/environment selection. Missing/unknown observations remain unobserved and are not zero. Raw scan endpoints and maxima are non-atomic, partially resident observations.

comparison.PSS_coverage_scope: All 24 raw streams independently rescanned. The aggregate publishes observed-block/range coverage; per-sample coverage/unknown counts are independently checked against each block peer, and retained here.
comparison.descriptive_statistics: Median/min/max/sample SD checked for every published arm and ratio metric. Independently derived means and PSS SD are additional descriptive values, not fields published by ACTUAL_AGGREGATE.
comparison.rounding_explanation: The peer divides exact decimal/ns durations and rounds ratios once; the aggregate divides serialized binary64 seconds. Small last-bit ratio differences and resulting summary differences are accepted at rel_tol2e-14/abs_tol1e-12. Every raw arm by-block timing and every PSS byte value is required exact.

method: Standard-library JSON and streamed tar/JSONL reads only; no extraction to disk, graph/ML imports, new tests/frameworks, source edits, network or cluster action. Exact rational paired ratios rounded once; sample SD uses n-1.
no_failed_pooling_scope: The measured set is exactly the three original repetitions, with eight successful normal-wait applications per audited block and no extra/missing application reports. All block receipts disable automatic retry; aggregate pins exactly those three archives. No other attempt or cohort contributes a measured row. This does not claim no excluded failures ever existed.
scope: Three audited actual blocks only. All raw report/exit arithmetic, per-block ratios and across-block summaries are recomputed. Archive members rehashed and source/digest/prefix maps checked without executing or inspecting frozen source implementation. Source-bound consumed tensor hashes are serialized attestations; tensor bytes were not regenerated or independently rehashed. No time-to-quality, universal native cost, population uncertainty or exact memory-peak claim.
